root = Stack([ClassControl, GoldControl, BagWeightControl, AllowanceDisplay, FeeDisplay])

ClassControl = Control("Class",0,1,["Economy","Business"],$class)
GoldControl = Control("Gold status",0,1,["No","Yes"],$gold)
BagWeightControl = Control("Bag weight (kg)",10,40,[], $bagWeight)

Allowance = (class == 0 ? 23 : 32) + (gold == 1 ? 5 : 0)
Excess = bagWeight > Allowance ? bagWeight - Allowance : 0
Fee = Excess * 15

AllowanceDisplay = Text("Allowance: " + Allowance + " kg")
FeeDisplay = Text("Fee: $" + Fee)

Build an interactive single-bag fee explorer for a fictional policy. Economy allows 23 kg, Business 32 kg; Gold adds 5 kg. Charge $15 per excess kg, never negative. Support all integer bag weights from 10 to 40 kg. Show allowance and fee as inputs change.

This interactive explorer lets you select your travel class (Economy or Business), Gold status (No or Yes), and your bag weight (10 to 40 kg).
